sources.claims: Complete competitive fixture ledger: selection and chronology.
Seventh place, 63 points, 11 league defeats, seven points behind fourth-placed Tottenham.
Sunderland 1–0 Liverpool: A unique decisive outside interference incident in a damaging fourth league defeat.
Liverpool 2–0 Manchester United: Ends four successive defeats; a third consecutive league win over United.
Lyon 1–1 Liverpool: Late concession leaves Liverpool on brink of Champions League group elimination; Babel goal denied victory.
Liverpool 1–2 Reading after extra time: Third-round replay loss to Championship opposition after late penalty and extra-time winner.
Liverpool 1–0 Everton: Ten-man Liverpool win derby through Kuyt after Kyrgiakos dismissal.
Liverpool 3–0 Lille: Overturns one-goal first-leg deficit to reach Europa League quarter-final.
Liverpool 4–1 Benfica: Another first-leg deficit overturned; Torres double takes Liverpool to semi-final.
Liverpool 2–1 Atlético Madrid after extra time: Extra-time away goal ends final European campaign of Benítez’s Liverpool tenure.
